last.verdict: Investors sold J&J despite a raised outlook, focusing on a weak profit and soft MedTech.

reasons.label: Talc charge crushed profit
reasons.text: Reported earnings fell 96% to $210 million on a one-time talc litigation charge.

reasons.label: Weak medical devices
reasons.text: MedTech sales grew only 2.5%, and management said this fell short of its own expectations.

reasons.label: Small guidance bump
reasons.text: Full-year profit outlook rose just $0.06 to $11.10, modest after a strong run in the shares.

story: J&J has grown sales about 6% a quarter and kept nudging its yearly outlook up. Drug sales are strong, but Stelara's loss of sales to cheaper copies and a slower device business hold it back. Shares slipped after July's report too.
